_about: Made-up scripted replies for DA_LLM_PROVIDER=fake (decision D-C). They walk the Excel example from the demo and ignore what is typed. A step that comes up again reuses its entry; a step not listed here gets an empty reply.

opening.hint: Is the goal to let Excel content go through the same document-ingestion flow as PDFs?

updates.title: Add Excel document processing
updates.objective: Let users upload Excel workbooks so their content goes through the same document-ingestion flow as PDFs.
updates.reason: Teams keep technical inventories in Excel and must convert them to PDF before uploading.

question_1.hint: Which screen or step stops Excel files right now?

updates.current_behaviour: The upload screen accepts only PDF and DOCX files. Excel files are rejected during file-type validation.

question_2.hint: Describe the end-to-end behaviour you expect.

updates.expected_behaviour: CodeVision validates the Excel file, extracts the content from the worksheets, and passes it into the existing ingestion process.
functional_flow: The user uploads an Excel workbook on the upload screen
The file-type check accepts the workbook
The content of the worksheets is extracted
The extracted content goes into the existing ingestion process
in_scope: Accept Excel workbooks on the upload screen
Extract worksheet content into the existing ingestion flow

question_3.hint: Think about what could go wrong, not only the happy path.

updates.inputs: Excel workbooks uploaded by the user
updates.outputs: Worksheet content in the normal ingestion format
out_of_scope: Macros and formulas in the workbook
